name: magic-compact
title_zh: 一键压缩当前 Claude Code 会话上下文
tagline_zh: 会话越聊越长，上下文快爆了？敲一下就把历史压成摘要，腾出窗口继续干，不用开新会话重讲一遍。
tagline_en: Session dragging on and context about to blow? One command compresses the history into a summary, freeing the.
why_zh: 它把对话历史就地蒸馏成结构化摘要，保留关键决策与未竟事项，而非粗暴截断。压缩后仍可续聊。
why_en: It distills the conversation in-place into a structured digest—key decisions and open threads preserved, not just truncated.
limit_zh: 只适用于 Claude Code 的交互式会话，不处理纯脚本或管道输入；压缩后原始逐字记录即被丢弃，无法回滚。
limit_en: Only works inside interactive Claude Code sessions, not scripts or piped input. Original verbatim transcript is discarded after compaction—no.
